caption_hook: 🌕 NASA picked a mission to find out if a deep pit on the Moon opens into a huge lava-tube cave + 3 more wins you missed 👇
question: Moon cave or clean fusion: which excites you more?
share_line: Send this to the friend who loves space

first_comment: Bonus: the team will set off seismic signals on the Moon, something essentially not done since the Apollo astronauts. Would you camp in a Moon cave? 🌕

stories.headline: NASA's GIMLI mission will hunt for a cave under the Moon
stories.summary: A lander and rover will use radar, seismic sensors, a gravimeter and cameras to see if the Marius Hills pit opens into a vast lava tube, and measure how big it is.
stories.why: A cave could shield future astronauts from radiation and wild temperature swings.

stories.headline: Free music classes now reach 20,000+ kids in Miami
stories.summary: A local nonprofit teaches instruments for free in 131 schools across Miami-Dade. Some former students now lead the classes, like trumpet teacher Reinaldo Velez.
stories.why: Kids gain friends, confidence and a lifelong skill, at no cost to families.

stories.headline: A pomegranate compound may help stiff hearts relax
stories.summary: King's College London found urolithin A, made in the body after eating pomegranates, walnuts and some berries, improved the heart's ability to relax and cut scarring.
stories.why: It has already been tested in people and looks safe, so treatments could follow.

stories.headline: China achieves the 1st fusion with clean hydrogen-boron fuel
stories.summary: Engineers at ENN Group briefly fused hydrogen and boron-11 in a spherical tokamak. The reaction makes helium and energy without the high-energy neutrons of standard fusion fuel.
stories.why: Boron is abundant and the reaction makes no radioactive waste.

fun_fact: Lava tubes are common on Earth; finding one on the Moon would let scientists use Earth caves as a guide.
